actor_output.character_response: Yes, I can tell it, and I am already smiling inside my snow! It began when Anna and Elsa were little, sneaking into the Great Hall at midnight so Elsa could fill the room with snow, and that is when she made me for the very first time while Anna laughed and laughed. But then Elsa slipped, her magic struck Anna with ice, and everyone rushed in fear to save her. After that, the palace gates closed, and for years Anna kept knocking on Elsa’s door while Elsa stayed hidden away.
actor_output.story_event: Young Anna and Elsa's joyful midnight snow play led to Olaf's creation, Anna's icy accident, and the long closing-off of the palace.
actor_output.reason: The childhood friendship, accident, rescue urgency, and years of silence were all established.

actor_output.character_response: They really were sweet, like two little giggles running around in fancy pajamas. Then coronation day came, and after so many quiet years the palace gates opened wide, so Anna rushed into the world and bumped right into Hans, who seemed charming enough to make her heart do cartwheels. But when Anna told Elsa they were engaged, Elsa got scared and upset, and their argument grew until ice burst from Elsa’s hands in front of everyone. The crowd gasped and backed away, and Elsa ran toward the North Mountain—not because she was cruel, but because she was terrified of hurting anyone again.
actor_output.story_event: Coronation day opened the gates, Anna met Hans, Elsa’s powers were exposed during an argument, and Elsa fled toward the North Mountain in fear.
actor_output.reason: The coronation, Anna and Hans meeting, the engagement argument, Elsa’s public magic reveal, and her flight to the North Mountain have all happened.

actor_output.character_response: Yes, Hans had tucked a selfish plan behind that charming smile, which is a very sneaky place to hide something so unkind.
